question: Which of the following sports was initially known as Poona?
solution:
Correct Answer **Badminton**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

 
• The game of **Badminton** originated in **Pune (Poona), now in Maharashtra state.**
 
• For the same reason, the game was also known as **Poona or Poonah **after the** garrison town of Poona.**
 
• Extra:-
 
• Since **1992, badminton has been a Summer Olympic sport.**

The Olympics includes five events:

 
• Men's singles, women's singles, men's doubles, and women's doubles and mixed doubles.
 
• **Badminton World Federation (BWF)** is the **highest international governing body** of the sport.
 
• Indian shuttlers **Saina Nehwal, K. Srikanth and P.V. Sindhu **are ranked amongst **top-10 in current BWF ranking.**
 
• **Prakash Padukone** was the **first player** from India to achieve **world no.1 spot in the game.**
 
• **K. Srikanth **was the **second male** to be ranked the top in **male category **after **Prakash Padukone in April 2018.**
 
• Saina Nehwal is the first female player from India to achieve **World no.1 spot in April 2015.**
 
• Kento MOMOTA from Japan is currently the highest-ranked** male singles Badminton Player.**
 
• TAI Tzu Ying from Taipei is currently the highest-ranked **female singles Badminton Player.**
